name: The Seattle Times editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Seattle Times Center (low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026), and Ad Fontes rates it Middle (-7.06). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: The Stranger Election Control Board
lean_basis: Ad Fontes rates The Stranger Hyper-Partisan Left (-18.18). No AllSides rating was found.

name: League of Women Voters of Washington
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that says 'The League of Women Voters is a nonpartisan political organization' (https://lwvwa.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Washington State Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its website says the state party does not endorse candidates; county and legislative-district Democratic organizations do.

name: Washington State Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. In 2026 it issued 'official recommendations' in the nonpartisan Supreme Court races and urges a YES on all three initiatives.

name: Washington State Labor Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation that calls itself 'the largest labor organization in Washington state' (https://wslc.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Association of Washington Business
lean_basis: The state chamber of commerce, which calls itself 'Washington State's Premier Business Organization' (https://www.awb.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Washington Education Association
lean_basis: Statewide teachers' union that calls itself 'a union that elevates the collective voice of professional public school educators' (https://www.washingtonea.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Washington State PTA
lean_basis: Parent-teacher association that calls itself 'an innovative, forward-thinking, and effective advocate for children' (https://www.wastatepta.org/about/) and does not endorse candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates (Washington)
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in Washington. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: ACLU of Washington
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national ACLU Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, checked Oct. 2026). This is its Washington affiliate.

name: Let's Go Washington (I-645 sponsor)
lean_basis: Initiative committee whose 2026 measures include one to 'repeal the income tax' (https://letsgowashington.com/faqs/), an anti-tax cause. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Washington House Republicans (caucus)
lean_basis: The Republican caucus of the state House; hosts explainer pages supporting the 2026 initiatives. Does not endorse in judicial races.
